name: Dense graphs with every edge essential for diameter two
description: construct() -> simple undirected edges on vertices 0..15. The graph must have diameter exactly two. Deleting EACH individual edge must increase its diameter above two or disconnect it. Maximize edge count; the evaluator repeats exact all-pairs BFS for every edge deletion. Only sixteen vertices are searched; finite candidates provide lower constructions, not upper-bound proofs for every order. The star seed is an elementary complete bipartite example. No novelty or unresolved status of this small order is asserted.
